CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2598 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b. Bus nonce: b3556ac8bcb1d8243375ea138f87fe38. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b` or `Fix review: blocked 0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: b3556ac8bcb1d8243375ea138f87fe38`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2598 0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2598-b3556ac8`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2598, the roster sync PR for round 10 (group R10-ROSTER), at head 0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b. It carries dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json from handoff/audit-r10-roster (tip 5620151813e) onto main, plus its delivery row. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.

- Confirm the roster diff against main is exactly the roster-seat ops the body lists: new groups R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE, R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY and R10-TRAIN-OVERLAP-GRADE; R10-RCA-FRICTION done at 3976515a with 5 issues unwired; R10-FLOW-DESIGN-POLICY done at 6077bf70e; the R10-SCORES citation coordinator.py:10293 -> 10309; carries on R10-TRAIN-OVERLAP-GRADE, R10-FLOW-BOARD and R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY. Name anything else.
- Verify each done stage: the done SHA is on main, and the group's brief checklist is met there (for R10-FLOW-DESIGN-POLICY, every checklist item at 6077bf70e). Verify the R10-SCORES citation resolves at origin/main: `heat_loss_coefficient` is in _scores_view near coordinator.py:10309.
- Run node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs at the head: 0 errors. carry_audit.py check over the body: 0 unrouted. Every Carry in your verdict names a live group on main's roster.
- Re-measure every figure in the body; read check-runs at this head (nightly-status grades main). git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 0c563c12e1ace15d5e2c73dc0a19f9fca1953f2b must be clean.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: b3556ac8bcb1d8243375ea138f87fe38. No /Users/ or /private/ path in VERDICT.md or ev/.
